name: @playform/ets-lib-dsh-core
description: The CORE: the pure, harness-free commonalities of the governance family (@playform/ets-lib-dsh-core) — the dependency-section list, the exclusion-segment list, the suppression-line composer, the update-policy loader and the refusal guard — the EFFECT-TS, effect-backed build of the ets-* group. A NEW governance module reduces to a Config extension, a pure transform and an update engine; the core owns the shared pure mechanics and the module's ledger strings stay module-side. Usable outside the harness entirely (the PlayForm ecosystem).
